patches.description: Get rewards without watching ads. Combine with No Ads for other formats, but keep No Ads' rewarded block off.
patches.name: Ads Free Rewards

options.description: Choose the implementation to use. Each version is a snapshot - newer ones support more networks. If the latest does not work for your app, try an older version.
options.title: Patch version

options.description: Which ad-network integration to patch. 'Auto' covers every supported network
options.title: Reward Strategy

options.description: Claim the reward immediately without showing an ad (applies to the current patch version)
options.title: Instant reward

options.description: Force ad SDKs to report ads as available so the reward flow triggers (needed when no real ad can fill)
options.title: Fake ad availability

patches.description: Get paid items free: buying grants items without charging. Best for offline games.
patches.name: Free In-app Purchases

options.description: Deliver a fake owned purchase on every inventory query. Helps games that only grant at boot, but can stall strict Unity titles. Leave off if a game hangs on loading.
options.title: Fake owned purchases at startup

patches.description: Blocks ads by type. Pick what to block. For rewarded ads use Ads Free Rewards instead.
patches.name: No Ads

options.description: Quick setup: Recommended blocks most ads but keeps rewarded ads for Ads Free Rewards compatibility. Aggressive blocks everything including rewarded. Custom lets you pick below.
options.title: Preset

options.description: Full-screen ads between levels or menus. Safe to block in most apps.
options.title: Block Interstitials

options.description: Thin banners at top/bottom. Safe to block; rarely breaks layout.
options.title: Block Banners

options.description: Ads on cold start. Block to skip the launch ad.
options.title: Block App Open

options.description: Medium rectangles (300x250) inside feeds. Safe to block.
options.title: Block MREC

options.description: Rewarded video  -  disable if you use Ads Free Rewards, otherwise progress gates may break. Enable only to fully remove rewarded ads.
options.title: Block Rewarded

options.description: Native ads blended into feeds/lists. Enable for cleaner feeds (may leave empty placeholders).
options.title: Block Native

patches.description: Bypass app protection so the patched app can start.
patches.name: Pairip Bypass

options.description: Spoof checks that verify which installer installed the app.
options.title: Local installer checks

options.description: Report Play Store installation (integrated Spoof Play Store Install Source).
options.title: Play Store install spoof

options.description: Bypass both PairIP StartupLauncher.launch and StartupLauncher.pairip entry points.
options.title: StartupLauncher checks

options.description: Add Firebase manifest switches that stop Analytics, Messaging, Crashlytics and Performance from auto-initializing, and remove the measurement init provider, receiver and services. For apps that crash at startup in ScionFrontendApi (broken Dynamite loading).
options.title: Disable Firebase

patches.description: Unlock premium features and remove paywalls.
patches.name: Unlock Premium

options.description: Comma-separated extra SharedPreferences/DataStore keys to spoof (e.g. my_premium,my_pro). Leave empty for default list.
options.title: Extra keys
